title: WAN2GP unveils free AI video studio for mid-range GPUs with #WAN2GP #freeaivideo #aivideostudio
description: WAN2GP launched a free, open source AI video studio that runs entirely on a laptop without needing expensive GPUs. It supports mid-range Nvidia GPUs with 6GB VRAM and offers access to top open video models like WAN 2.1, Hunyuan Video, and LTX Video through a simple browser interface. The platform delivers a full AI video production suite including text-to-video, image-to-video, video restoration, auto-generated audio, LoRA support, and a talking head feature for animating speakers with custom voices. Running locally ensures privacy for creators while eliminating costly cloud subscriptions. Designed for users with limited hardware, WAN2GP democratizes cinematic AI video creation by making advanced tools accessible and affordable for independent creators and small studios. #WAN2GP #DeepBeepMeep #AIvideoStudio #OpenSourceAI #AIVideoGeneration #TextToVideo #VideoRestoration #NvidiaGPU #CreativeTech #LocalAIVideo #AIVideoTools #MidRangeGPU #AIContentCreation #AIInnovation #VideoTech
